# LossOfControlMessages by D4KiR

## [v1.3.9](https://github.com/d4kir92/LossOfControlMessages/tree/v1.3.9) (2026-11-14)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/d4kir92/LossOfControlMessages/compare/v1.3.8...v1.3.9) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/d4kir92/LossOfControlMessages/releases)

- v1.3.9  
- Add optional generic message when loss of control data is hidden  
    - New option: send a generic "Lost control!" message when Blizzard hides the loss of control details (off by default)  
    - Generic message respects group, instance, role and chat lockdown settings and is throttled to once every 5 seconds  
    - Added translations for the new option in all languages  
    - Sorted locale files alphabetically  
- d4lib
